rows.heading: # VisualCore Application Brainstorm
rows.note: Title and metadata (status: exploration and planning, 2026-11-09). All 25 concepts later became mandatory and are now the free experiences A01-A25 (ADR-0009 D-02).

rows.heading: ## 1. Executive Summary
rows.note: The portfolio of separate applications became registered experiences in one app (ADR-0009 D-01). The principle 'different capabilities of one engine, not ProjectM variants' still holds.

rows.heading: ## 2. Existing Technical Foundation
rows.note: Section heading. The ANGLE-backed foundation was audited (gate F00) and wrapped by VisualCoreRendering.RenderHost (gate F02); see the subsections.

rows.heading: ### 2.1 Rendering architecture
rows.note: Stack as built: app code, VisualCore modules, RenderHost over EGL, ANGLE Metal backend (ADR-0002, gate F02, docs/architecture/visualcore-architecture.md). The app boxes in the diagram are now experiences.

rows.heading: ### 2.2 Important architectural decisions
rows.note: All eight decisions are in constitution I, II and II-a and were followed in gates F00-F09 (ADR-0002, ADR-0003). Native Metal stays excluded without a test-backed ADR (ADR-0009 D-09).

rows.heading: ### 2.3 VisualCore's intended role
rows.note: Built as optional modules driven by real consumers, not a game engine: 15 Swift modules in two packages (gates F01-F09, extended in A01-A04; API baseline docs/api/visualcore-public-api.txt).

rows.heading: ## 3. Application Idea Catalog
rows.note: 'Concepts, not commitments' no longer holds: all 25 are launch experiences in the free tier (ADR-0009 D-02). The concept texts are carried in docs/catalog/experience-catalog.json.

rows.heading: ### 3.1 Creative and visual applications
rows.note: Family of A01-A05 (launcher category create). A01-A03 are complete standalone apps, A04 is partial, A05 is not started; all five still need their integration gates X-A01 to X-A05.

rows.heading: #### 1. Generative Art Studio
rows.note: A01: standalone app sealed by gates A01-P00 to A01-P06 (specs/011 to specs/017), simulators only. Adoption as experience a01.generative-art-studio (UA-F07, X-A01) and device rows are pending.

rows.heading: #### 2. Fluid Art Playground
rows.note: A02: standalone app sealed by gates A02-P00 to A02-P06 (specs/018 to specs/024), simulators only. Integration gate X-A02 and device rows are pending.

rows.heading: #### 3. Fractal Explorer
rows.note: A03: standalone app sealed by gates A03-P00 to A03-P06 (specs/025 to specs/031), simulators only. Integration gate X-A03 and device rows are pending.

rows.heading: #### 4. Particle Universe
rows.note: A04: gates A04-P00 to A04-P03 are sealed (specs/032 to specs/035); A04-P04 to A04-P06 and X-A04 are pending. Particles are simulated on the CPU and drawn instanced, not simulated on the GPU.

rows.heading: #### 5. Infinite Geometry
rows.note: A05: not started (gates A05-P00 to A05-P06, specs 039-045). Needs procedural meshes and 3D camera work beyond today's plane, cube and sphere generators and the single-mesh MeshRenderer.

rows.heading: ### 3.2 Music, audio, and entertainment
rows.note: Family of A06-A09 (launcher category audio). None started. A06-A08 need VisualCoreAudio and VisualCoreAudioDSP, which are placeholders today (ADR-0006).

rows.heading: #### 6. VisualCore Music Lab
rows.note: A06: not started (specs 046-052). Depends on microphone and in-app audio taps and FFT features that do not exist yet (ADR-0006). Capture of other apps' audio stays excluded.

rows.heading: #### 7. Audio Odyssey
rows.note: A07: not started (specs 053-059). Needs audio features and a depth-buffered 3D scene path that the framework lacks. 'Scene packs' must not become paid add-ons (ADR-0009 D-03).

rows.heading: #### 8. Oscilloscope Studio
rows.note: A08: not started (specs 060-066). Line primitives exist; audio acquisition and waveform buffers do not. Microphone claims need device evidence, which comes only after the lock (ADR-0006 item 3, D-07).

rows.heading: #### 9. Digital Aquarium
rows.note: A09: not started (specs 067-073). Fish, plants and habitats must be procedural (ADR-0009 D-09). The framework has flat 2D primitives and instanced particles but no textured sprite batch.

rows.heading: ### 3.3 Games and interactive experiences
rows.note: Family of A10-A13 (launcher category play). None started. The framework has no collision or physics module yet.

rows.heading: #### 10. Neon Arcade
rows.note: A10: not started (specs 074-080). Fixed-step loop, touch input and particles exist; collision rules, sound, haptics and game-controller input do not (controllers: ADR-0006).

rows.heading: #### 11. Physics Playground
rows.note: A11: not started (specs 081-087). Needs a deterministic rigid-body and spring solver; nothing of that kind exists in VisualCoreSimulation yet.

rows.heading: #### 12. Tiny Worlds
rows.note: A12: not started (specs 088-094). Needs depth-buffered 3D, materials and procedural meshes. 'Collectible environments' must remain free content of the free tier (ADR-0009 D-03).

rows.heading: #### 13. Light Maze
rows.note: A13: not started (specs 095-101). A pure ray and reflection solver with level fixtures is to be built; render targets, shaders and touch input exist.

rows.heading: ### 3.4 Education and scientific visualization
rows.note: Family of A14-A17 (launcher category learn). None started. Scientific content needs cited sources and units (constitution X); geometry must be generated by code (ADR-0009 D-09).

rows.heading: #### 14. Solar System Explorer
rows.note: A14: not started (specs 102-108). Needs depth-buffered 3D spheres with materials and an orbit model with stated accuracy; planet surfaces must be procedural (ADR-0009 D-09).

rows.heading: #### 15. Molecular Explorer
rows.note: A15: not started (specs 109-115). Needs instanced mesh drawing (only particles are instanced today), 3D picking and a bounded, fuzz-tested molecule parser.

rows.heading: #### 16. Simulation Lab
rows.note: A16: not started (specs 116-122). The field passes, ping-pong targets and CPU reference grids built for A02 (FieldPass, PingPongTarget, FieldGrid) are the starting point.

rows.heading: #### 17. Interactive Anatomy
rows.note: A17: not started (specs 123-129). Open conflict: the concept needs anatomical 3D models and textures, while ADR-0009 D-09 excludes human-made or purchased models and D-02 forbids substitution.

rows.heading: ### 3.5 Ambient, personalization, and lifestyle
rows.note: Family of A18-A21 (launcher category ambient). None started. Long-running thermal and battery behavior can only be proven on devices, after the lock (ADR-0009 D-07).

rows.heading: #### 18. Ambient Clock
rows.note: A18: not started (specs 130-136). Text stays native SwiftUI over the GL scene (no glyph renderer exists). 'Premium themes' contradicts the free tier and the single purchase (ADR-0009 D-03).

rows.heading: #### 19. Living Wallpapers
rows.note: A19: not started (specs 137-143). Offscreen still export exists (RenderHost.renderOffscreen, A01-P04); video export does not. No live home-screen wallpaper claim (constitution VIII).

rows.heading: #### 20. Digital Zen Garden
rows.note: A20: not started (specs 144-150). Touch input, feedback targets and DocumentStore persistence exist and are to be reused.

rows.heading: #### 21. Aurora
rows.note: A21: not started (specs 151-157). The noise GLSL library and particles exist. 'Optional soundscapes' would need procedural audio output, which the framework does not have.

rows.heading: ### 3.6 Developer and creator tools
rows.note: Family of A22-A25 (launcher category tools). None started. User-authored shaders and graphs must be bounded and cycle-checked (constitution IX).

rows.heading: #### 22. Shader Studio
rows.note: A22: not started (specs 158-164). ShaderLibrary and line-mapped diagnostics exist; user GLSL needs size, time and memory limits and a last-good fallback. Sharing must work without an account (D-03).

rows.heading: #### 23. Visual Programming Lab
rows.note: A23: not started (specs 165-171). EffectGraphValidator (cycle rejection, quotas) is the base; a typed node-graph model and its serialization are new.

rows.heading: #### 24. Graphics Benchmark Lab
rows.note: A24: not started (specs 172-178). Its core value, GPU performance measurement, is device-only: under ADR-0009 D-07 it ships simulator-verified methods with results pending hardware verification.

rows.heading: #### 25. Effects Composer
rows.note: A25: not started (specs 179-185). Builds on VisualCoreEffects (eight pass types, limits of 32 passes and 256 MiB), Preset and offscreen export. User image import needs image decoding, which does not exist.

rows.heading: ## 4. Initial Product Prioritization
rows.note: First-pass ranking of ten concepts without market data. Not used: the legacy ledger builds A01-A25 in numeric order (ADR-0009 D-12). The rank column survives only in the manuals index.

rows.heading: ### 4.1 Selection criteria for a more rigorous ranking
rows.note: Ten criteria for a future scoring model; never applied to the 25 apps (the 62-criterion study in docs/brainstorm/ did this for the round games). Its monetization options are void (ADR-0009 D-03).

rows.heading: ## 5. Recommended Application Portfolio
rows.note: Brainstorming not selected: 'start with a small portfolio instead of all 25' was overruled first by the 25-app suite and now by the 100-experience launch scope (ADR-0009 D-02).

rows.heading: ### 5.1 First product: VisualCore Studio
rows.note: Never specified or built as a product. Its idea, one app combining generative art, fractals, particles and fluids with presets, is now served by the unified app itself (ADR-0009 D-01).

rows.heading: ### 5.2 Second product: Digital Aquarium
rows.note: Feature ideas for A09 (not started). The archived manual apps/09-digital-aquarium.md and the catalog are the specification; the 'second product' ordering was not adopted.

rows.heading: ### 5.3 Third product: Simulation Lab
rows.note: Feature ideas for A16 (not started). The archived manual apps/16-simulation-lab.md and the catalog are the specification; the 'third product' ordering was not adopted.

rows.heading: ### 5.4 Additional products after the first three
rows.note: Shader Studio (A22), Audio Odyssey (A07), Digital Zen Garden (A20) and Effects Composer (A25): all still required, none started.

rows.heading: ## 6. VisualCore Capability-to-Application Validation Matrix
rows.note: Of 15 capabilities, 9 are sealed (EGL lifecycle, shaders, framebuffers, feedback, particles, gestures, offscreen, effect graph, presets). Sprites, 3D scenes, materials, audio, GPU profiling, assets are not.

rows.heading: ### 6.1 Acceptance principle
rows.note: Still the rule for every framework capability: a real consumer, a behavioral contract, tests, a sample, lifecycle and error behavior, measurements and documentation (constitution II).

rows.heading: ## 7. Proposed VisualCore Module Ecosystem
rows.note: The nine candidate areas were regrouped into the modules of two packages by ADR-0003 and package-map.md. The subsections name where each area lives today.

rows.heading: ### 7.1 VisualCore Runtime
rows.note: RenderHost, EGLDisplayProvider, RenderView, FrameScheduler and the RenderLifecycle states (gate F02, specs/003-rendering-lifecycle); simulators only.

rows.heading: ### 7.2 VisualCore Graphics
rows.note: ShaderProgram, Texture, GPUBuffer, RenderTarget, GLState, MeshRenderer, PrimitiveRenderer (gates F03, F05). No material system, and no depth or stencil attachment on targets or the window surface.

rows.heading: ### 7.3 VisualCore Effects
rows.note: Blur, bloom, distortion, color matrix, feedback, composite, copy and flash-limit passes (gate F04, specs/005-effects-graph); the graph model is in VisualCoreEffectsGraph.

rows.heading: ### 7.4 VisualCore Animation
rows.note: No module of that name: Timeline, Tween, SceneClock and FixedStepRunner here, EasingCurve and TourTimeline in VisualCoreMath (gates F05, A01-P02, A03-P04). No scene-transition service.

rows.heading: ### 7.5 VisualCore Particles
rows.note: ParticleSystem, Emitter, ParticleForce, TrailDecay here; ParticleRenderer and TrailLayer in VisualCoreRendering (gates F05, A04-P01 to A04-P03). Simulation runs on the CPU; drawing is instanced.

rows.heading: ### 7.6 VisualCore Scenes
rows.note: 2D SceneNode graph, Mesh generators, pointer and gesture input; Camera2D and OrbitCamera in VisualCoreMath (gate F05). 3D is limited to one Lambert-lit mesh per MeshRenderer; no transitions.

rows.heading: ### 7.7 VisualCore Audio
rows.note: Deliberately not built in F00-F09 (ADR-0006): VisualCoreAudio and VisualCoreAudioDSP hold a version constant only. Due with A06-A08; ProjectM audio code stays in the reference.

rows.heading: ### 7.8 VisualCore Assets
rows.note: ShaderBundle and Preset/NamedLibrary exist (A01-P01, A01-P03). Not built: image decoding into textures (needed for user image import in A25), asset validation and metrics. Art and models must be code (D-09).

rows.heading: ### 7.9 VisualCore Diagnostics
rows.note: Frame pacing, resource usage, lifecycle and device conditions here; shader diagnostics in VisualCoreShaderSource; reports in VisualCoreAutomation (gates F02, F03, F09). No GPU timing, no shared overlay.

rows.heading: ## 8. Suggested Development Roadmap
rows.note: Earlier ordering of the roadmap; the README version was the one executed (F00-F09). Phases 6-8 here (Studio, Simulation Lab and Aquarium as the first apps) were not adopted.

rows.heading: ### Phase 0 — Repository and rendering audit
rows.note: Same work as README Phase 0: gate F00 with the ADR-0004 rework; audit documents in docs/architecture/, baseline in docs/verification/projectm-baseline.md. Observations are simulator-only.

rows.heading: ### Phase 1 — Extract shared ANGLE/EGL integration
rows.note: Done as gate F02: RenderHost repeats the audited EGL sequence on the same ANGLE binaries (ADR-0002); the reference keeps building and passing its renderer tests.

rows.heading: ### Phase 2 — Establish VisualCore shared APIs
rows.note: Public API of 15 modules, reviewed and baselined since gate F09 (scripts/check_public_api.py). Every listed area has a consumer except the audio placeholders.

rows.heading: ### Phase 3 — Migrate ProjectM incrementally
rows.note: Done as a harness, not inside ProjectM: Harnesses/ProjectMReference runs the unmodified engine on RenderHost (gate F07). The shipping app is untouched (read-only submodule, ADR-0002).

rows.heading: ### Phase 4 — Build reusable shader and effects infrastructure
rows.note: Shader services (gate F03), effects (F04), PingPongTarget (A02-P01), parameter binding and presets (VisualCoreParameters, A01-P01). First consumer was Generative Art Studio, not VisualCore Studio.

rows.heading: ### Phase 5 — Add reusable scenes, particles, and interaction
rows.note: Gate F05: 2D primitives, timelines, particles, cameras, gestures. Not built: textured sprites, scene transitions and anything beyond a single lit mesh in 3D.

rows.heading: ### Phase 6 — Build the independent VisualCore Studio application
rows.note: Not selected: no VisualCore Studio app exists. Its acceptance test (a standalone app that needs no ProjectM code) was met by the Showcase (F06) and Generative Art Studio (A01).

rows.heading: ### Phase 7 — Build Simulation Lab
rows.note: Simulation Lab is A16 (not started, gates A16-P00 to A16-P06) and no longer an early framework phase. Its task list is covered by the archived manual.

rows.heading: ### Phase 8 — Build Digital Aquarium
rows.note: Digital Aquarium is A09 (not started, gates A09-P00 to A09-P06) and no longer an early framework phase.

rows.heading: ### Phase 9 — Stabilize, document, and release VisualCore
rows.note: Gate F09: API and dependency review, documentation, licenses, CI, baselines, release notes 1.0.0-rc.1. 'Device validation' did not happen; support-matrix.md lists D1-D3 as pending.

rows.note: The illustrative layout (Submodules/, Integrations/, eight packages, three apps) was not used: the submodule is at External/projectm-ios and packages follow ADR-0003; ADR-0009 D-06 sets the next layout.

rows.heading: ## 11. Claude Code Repository Instructions
rows.note: Suggested CLAUDE.md text; replaced by the agent contract (archived) and now by the small bootstrap of ADR-0009 D-10. Its rules are in the constitution and in Auto-Creator.md.

rows.heading: ## 12. Testing and Quality Strategy
rows.note: Section heading. Framework and regression tests exist and are sealed (gates F02-F09); performance validation on hardware has not started. See the subsections.

rows.heading: ### 12.1 Framework tests
rows.note: All ten cases are covered by VisualCoreRenderingTests and VisualCoreEffectsTests on iOS 27.2 and 26.5 simulators (gates F02-F04; cleanup sweep F09 T-F906). Orientation on real devices is untested.

rows.heading: ### 12.2 Application regression tests
rows.note: ProjectM stays the permanent reference workload: scripts/run_reference_baseline.py and the harness lockstep comparison with a synthetic signal (gate F07) are rerun after framework changes. No device comparison.

rows.heading: ### 12.3 Performance validation
rows.note: Measuring code exists (AutomationRunner frame statistics, DeviceConditions, simulator baselines from F09) but nothing was measured on hardware. The record fields carry into the device protocol.

rows.heading: ### 12.4 Platform constraints
rows.note: Standing facts: builds need macOS and Xcode, simulators never replace device performance tests, export features must use public platform APIs (constitution VIII). The Windows note is moot.

rows.heading: ## 13. Python Automation Opportunities
rows.note: Realized in scripts/ under other names: inventory_reference.py, check_dependencies.py, check_licenses.py, simulator_baselines.py, run_reference_baseline.py (gates F00-F09). No shader script exists.

rows.heading: ## 14. Risks and Mitigations
rows.note: Risk register of the brainstorm; the mitigations were applied in F00-F09. 'Excessive product scope' and 'unvalidated market assumptions' were accepted by the owner (ADR-0009 D-02 fixes 100 experiences).

rows.heading: ## 15. Product Strategy and Commercial Considerations
rows.note: The monetization options (paid app, paid packs, feature unlock, subscription) are replaced by one USD 1.99 non-consumable for the premium library; A01-A25 are free forever (ADR-0009 D-02, D-03).

rows.heading: ## 16. Recommended Long-Term Sequence
rows.note: Sequence not adopted (Studio, Fluid, Aquarium, Simulation Lab, Shader Studio). Actual order: F00-F09, then A01 to A25 numerically in the legacy ledger (ADR-0009 D-12).

rows.heading: ## 17. Immediate Next Steps
rows.note: Ten bootstrap steps of 2026-11-09; steps 1-9 were completed by F00-F02. Step 10 ('the portfolio is a roadmap, not a commitment') was overruled: all 25 are required (ADR-0009 D-02).

rows.heading: ## 18. Final Recommendation
rows.note: The four-product portfolio (ProjectM, Studio, Aquarium, Simulation Lab) gave way to one app with 100 experiences (ADR-0009 D-01, D-02). The aim of a reusable foundation is unchanged (AC-13).
